question: Who wrote 'Ain-i-Akbari'? It is a 16th-century detailed document recording the administration of the Mughal Empire under Emperor Akbar.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abul Fazl**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Abul Fazl** was the author of 'Ain-i-Akbari'.
 
• 'Ain-i-Akbari' is a 16th-century detailed document recording the administration of the Mughal Empire under Emperor Akbar.
